programs.description: Four lifelong friends are frustrated from their respective lives, so Sam decides to take them to his farmhouse for a break. He invites a call-girl but whenever Sam tries to touch her, various characters ring the doorbell and disturb him.
Host Jay Raval chats with singer Purva Mantri about her creative journey, unique musical style, and insights into the indie music scene.
